The "Big 3" pharmaceutical wholesale distributors in the United States are
McKesson Corporation
Cencora
(formerly AmerisourceBergen), and
Cardinal Health
. Together, these three massive companies handle well over 90 percent of the nation's total prescription drug distribution.
Pharmaceutical Commerce
Company Details
McKesson Corporation:
The largest of the three, distributing roughly one-third of all pharmaceuticals used in North America.
Cencora:
Formerly known as AmerisourceBergen before rebranding [0.2], a global healthcare solutions leader specializing in complex and oncology drug distribution.
Cardinal Health:
A major distributor of pharmaceuticals as well as extensive medical, surgical, and laboratory products to healthcare providers.

[Shanghai Pharmaceuticals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanghai_Pharmaceuticals) is a major Chinese health care company. It runs a massive drug distribution network and makes its own medicines. It handles thousands of drug types, traditional Chinese medicines, and imported therapies by partnering with large global and domestic drug makers. [](https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/shanghai-pharmaceutical-co-ltd/)

- **Modern and Innovative Drugs:** Prescription medicines covering central nervous system (CNS), cardiovascular, metabolic, immunology, and rare diseases. [](https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/contractors/pharma-wholesalers/shanghai-pharmaceuticals-holding-co-ltd/)

- **Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM):** Well-known herbal formulas and classical TCM preparations produced via its manufacturing sector. [](https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/shanghai-pharmaceutical-co-ltd/)

- **Ophthalmic and Specialty Lines:** Specializ
